Forming two specialist companies within the Group, TPT Fire Projects and TPT Fire Maintenance, to deliver a complete, end-to-end fire protection service. Today, the Group is led by Managing Director Spencer Thompson, who continues the legacy established by his father. From our roots in Hampshire to a nationwide presence, we remain proudly family-owned and guided by the same core values of trust, reliability, and commitment to protecting lives and property. [service: https://www.tpt-fire.co.uk/maintenanceservices]  Service & Maintenance Design & Installation About Us Events Training Centre Recruitment Contact Service & Maintenance Trusted by  Service & Maintenance At TPT Fire Maintenance, we specialise in the servicing, repair, and testing of fire sprinkler systems, ensuring full compliance with the latest British Standards, Technical Bulletins, and FM/UL regulations. Whether for residential or commercial properties, our priority is to keep every system safe, compliant, and ready to perform when it matters most. With a dedicated team of skilled engineers and a nationwide presence, we provide responsive, professional support tailored to each client’s needs. For our contract customers, we also offer a 24/7 emergency call-out service, giving you complete peace of mind day or night. Talk to us today Maintenance Services Automatic Sprinklers We service and maintain automatic sprinkler systems in full accordance with BS EN 12845 and LPC Rules, ensuring every system operates safely, efficiently, and in full compliance. Regular maintenance helps to extend system life, maintain insurance compliance, and ensure reliable performance when it’s needed most. Contact us Domestic Sprinkler Systems Our engineers maintain residential sprinkler systems to BS 9251, providing reliable fire protection for homes, apartments, and multi-occupancy buildings. We ensure every system is correctly tested, fully functional, and ready to protect lives and property in the event of a fire. Contact us Fire Pumps All fire pumps are tested and maintained in accordance with BS EN 12845, ensuring correct operation, flow, and pressure performance. Our dedicated pump department carries out all servicing in-house, supported by specialist engineers with extensive experience in fire protection systems. This approach guarantees consistent quality, technical expertise, and reliability without the need for third-party contractors. Contact us Water Storage Tanks We inspect and maintain sprinkler water storage tanks in accordance with BS EN 12845 and relevant LPC Technical Bulletins, ensuring ongoing structural integrity, cleanliness, and reliability. Regular inspections help identify corrosion, leaks, and other early signs of wear, safeguarding the long-term performance of your fire protection system. Contact us ROV Tank Inspections Working alongside our trusted and approved specialist partners, we use remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) to perform non-intrusive tank inspections that provide a detailed internal assessment of tank condition, all without the need for disruptive drain downs. This advanced robotic technology captures high-resolution imagery and data, enabling our engineers to evaluate internal surfaces, identify defects, and deliver comprehensive condition reports with clear, actionable recommendations for any remedial work required. Contact Main Switchboard: 01256 365 000 Maintenance maintenance@tpt-fire.co.uk 01256 365 040 Projects projects@tpt-fire.co.uk 01256 365 000 Out Of Hours Emergency Call Out No: 07979 522973  Follow Dry riser systems Our dry riser installations ensure that fire services can access a reliable water supply quickly and effectively in multi-storey buildings. A dry riser system is a network of empty pipework installed in tall buildings, allowing the fire service to deliver water rapidly to upper floors during an emergency. The system includes vertical and horizontal pipes with outlet valves on each floor and an inlet connection at ground level. In the event of a fire, firefighters connect their hoses to the inlet and pump water into the system, providing fast, direct access to water where it’s needed most. Dry risers are mandatory in buildings over 18 metres high (typically five storeys or more) under UK fire safety regulations. Regular testing and maintenance are essential to keep these systems ready for immediate use and full compliance. CLOSE Gas suppression systems We design and install gas suppression systems for sensitive environments such as server rooms, data centres, archives, and museums, providing rapid, water-free fire protection for critical assets. A gas suppression system is a specialist fire protection solution for areas where using water, foam or other fire suppression agents could cause serious damage.
